admission_and_stop_conditions: Freeze one exact hypothesis, manifest, deterministic TA-Lib-formula-compatible runner, costs, windows and all-pass gate set before opening any CCI outcome.

Run only the completed-day default CCI14 hysteresis state with primary enter above positive 100 and exit below negative 100, plus rejection-only symmetric 75 and 125 threshold neighbors. Do not run another period, price source, divisor, threshold, confirmation, stop, short, leverage, DRA interaction or ensemble.

Require positive normal and stress returns, materially better Validation drawdown and Calmar, frozen upside capture, annual breadth, bounded turnover and holding, low episode and year concentration and no terminal-inventory uplift; otherwise permanently close the exact family.
Any ambiguity in typical-price aggregation, mean absolute deviation, zero-deviation behavior, hysteresis initialization or next-open availability returns evidence insufficient without outcome access.
A positive historical result may create at most one REPORTED_NOT_ACTIVATED candidate and one independent sealed OOS gate; it authorizes no Trading action.
causal_hypothesis: A large completed-day typical-price displacement relative to its recent mean absolute deviation may identify unusually strong directional demand, while symmetric negative displacement may identify a sufficiently broad reversal to exit; hysteresis may preserve trends and reduce threshold churn before the next hourly fill.
claim_boundary: This prior makes one exact TA-Lib-default CCI14 symmetric-hysteresis family preregistration-ready only. It establishes formula identity, an executable free data path and a weak external motivation, not alpha, a candidate, OOS value, deployability or Trading authority.
economic_hypothesis: A full-capital BTC long-or-zero-yield-cash policy entering after completed-day CCI14 exceeds positive 100 and exiting only after it falls below negative 100 may improve fee- and slippage-adjusted drawdown and Calmar versus matched buy-and-hold only if it retains frozen upside, annual breadth and symmetric-threshold-neighbor stability.

frozen_pre_outcome_contract.neighbor_rationale: The nearest symmetric quarter-step bands around the conventional positive and negative 100 levels are frozen before outcome access solely to reject threshold fragility; neither neighbor may replace the primary.

independence_assessment.not_bollinger_mean_reversion: The closed Bollinger family bought a lower standard-deviation-band cross and exited an upper-band cross. This family follows positive typical-price displacement and exits on symmetric negative displacement using mean absolute deviation rather than standard deviation.
independence_assessment.not_fixed_sma_state: Although the sign of CCI alone would collapse to a typical-price-versus-SMA state, this preregistration uses conventional positive and negative 100 hysteresis boundaries and therefore preserves normalized displacement magnitude and prior state.
independence_assessment.not_mfi_or_obv: CCI uses no volume and no signed-volume accumulation; it normalizes typical-price displacement by recent price-path dispersion.
independence_assessment.not_rsi_stochastic_or_aroon: CCI is not a gain-loss ratio, range-location transform or extreme-recency clock. Its state depends on typical-price distance from a rolling average scaled by mean absolute deviation.
independence_assessment.residual_risk: CCI remains economically adjacent to the repeatedly weak technical trend cluster. Mathematical distinction does not establish independent alpha, so prior confidence is low and the family receives one frozen screen only.

missing_proof: The located BTC and ETH technical-indicator paper is favorable but does not establish that this exact default-period symmetric CCI hysteresis beats matched buy-and-hold under this corpus, cost model and frozen gates.

primary_prior_matrix.finding: The official function defines CCI as current typical price minus its N-period simple average, divided by 0.015 times the N-period mean absolute deviation. The official default period is 14.
primary_prior_matrix.parameter_boundary: This fixes the TA-Lib formula, default period, lookback and zero-deviation semantics. It supplies no BTC economic evidence and no permission to change formula, period, price aggregation or threshold after outcome access.

primary_prior_matrix.finding: The official documentation identifies positive 100 and negative 100 as the conventional CCI overbought and oversold extremes. This supports freezing those symmetric levels before seeing this corpus, while not deciding whether momentum continuation or reversal is economically valid.
primary_prior_matrix.identity: TA-Lib Commodity Channel Index threshold identity
primary_prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: Indicator convention does not establish BTC predictability. The direction, state persistence and next-open economics must pass the frozen historical gates.

primary_prior_matrix.finding: The peer-reviewed 2024 study includes CCI among technical-indicator holding strategies tested on Bitcoin and Ethereum against buy-and-hold and reports favorable aggregate holdings, drawdown and holding-period findings.
primary_prior_matrix.identity: Hong, Kang and Kim, Technical Indicator and Trading Time based Strategy for Increasing Bitcoin and Ethereum Holdings, Journal of Korea Academia-Industrial cooperation Society 25(9), 2024, DOI 10.5762/KAIS.2024.25.9.668
primary_prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: The abstract does not prove this exact formula, thresholds, timing, costs or Validation transfer. It only justifies one preregistered screen; it must not be used as a performance claim.

primary_prior_matrix.finding: The broad technical-rule study reports no Bitcoin predictability in its out-of-sample period despite wider in-sample and cross-crypto findings.
primary_prior_matrix.identity: Hudson and Urquhart, Technical trading and cryptocurrencies, Annals of Operations Research 297, 2021, DOI 10.1007/s10479-019-03357-1
primary_prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: A single exact CCI screen may be evaluated, but failure closes the family and a historical pass still requires independent sealed OOS.
